title: neoporteria subgibbosa f. major
intro: Neoporteria subgibbosa f. major, commonly known as the Chihuhuanan pincushion cactus, is a species of cactus in the family Echinocereus. This plant is known for its unique pincushion-like appearance, with numerous fine spines and vibrant flowers. The Chihuhuanan pincushion cactus has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe wounds, reduce pain, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
